description: Kujiondoa kwa kuelekezwa kwa Clustal. Mtu hufuata hatua kwenye orodha ya ukaguzi; OpenOptOut hutoa anwani ya barua pepe ya mara moja na kubofya kiungo cha uthibitisho.
instructions: Search clustal.org for {full_name}, open "view full record", and copy that page's address (the search result's address won't work). Fungua clustal.org/privacy-control, paste it, press "remove my info", enter {contact_email} and press "remove my info" again. Clustal emails a link to finish; OpenOptOut clicks it for you. Kisha bonyeza "Nimefanya hili".
